abi_facts.direct: canonical win_DrawBitMap entry ABI is fastcall AX/DX/BX (verified original DisplayCard callsite S24:39C7:083E); the original body has no BP+6/BP+8 input reads. This is distinct from the synthetic hook ABIs below.
abi_facts.g_9140: target body pushes four stack words in order [y1,x1,y0,x0] and adds SP,8; modeled screen-size host contract; not a same-named DOS helper ABI.
abi_facts.g_9148: target body pushes six stack words (buffer far pointer plus four coordinates) and adds SP,0C; modeled buffer transfer host contract; not a same-named DOS helper ABI.
abi_facts.original_decoders: o03_3258_040D/o01_32B5_000F/o00_35A6_0007 are called with six stack words and caller cleanup; original decoder bodies actually execute.

limitations: The g_9140/g_9148 slots are synthetic 4-/6-argument host contracts reusing physical addresses for dispatch; they do not invoke same-named DOS functions with incompatible signatures. Pixel transfer/screen size is a deterministic virtual screen contract; no physical framebuffer. Original type-3 decoder bodies do execute.
Finite directed/random domain only; not universal proof.
No registry or canonical source modified.
winprintf_diagnostic: WinPrintf is excluded as a semantic contract: DOS root:277D:000A is an empty one-byte RETF debug sink. Callsite varargs vary; render_small captures a fixed/truncated stack prefix (the DrawBalloons suite uses stack6 and bitmap calls include 7-word and 5-word payloads), so report helper traces are diagnostic and are not treated as complete variadic arguments, return semantics, or drawing effects. The original sink body has no state effects; this exclusion does not remove bitmap resource/pixel/geometry effects from the target contract.
